concepts.title: Rosetta end-of-support notification for translated apps
concepts.canonicalSummary: A macOS behaviour that alerts a user when they open an app relying on the Intel-translation layer, warning that such apps will stop running in a later macOS release. Organisations can shape how often the alert appears through a device-management restriction key.

citations.supports: Establishes the notification behaviour, its start point, the accelerated beta-period cadence, and the management key name.

citations.locator: macOS Tahoe 26.4 > list item beginning "Starting in macOS Tahoe 26.4"
citations.supports: Independently states the same notification behaviour and names the same management restriction key.

concepts.title: User-selectable battery charge ceiling on Mac
concepts.canonicalSummary: A battery setting that lets a person cap what the computer treats as a full charge. Charging stops near the chosen ceiling and resumes if the level falls far enough below it, with an on-demand option to reach a full charge.

citations.locator: Charge Limit > requirement line beginning "Requires macOS Tahoe 26.4"
citations.supports: Establishes the feature, its macOS and silicon requirements, the selectable range, and the resume behaviour.

citations.locator: Heading "macOS Tahoe 26.4"; none of the seven enhancement items beneath it names the charge ceiling
citations.supports: Records that Apple's user-facing what's-new list for this update does not itemise the feature.

concepts.title: Condensed tab strip choice in Safari
concepts.canonicalSummary: A Safari layout choice that condenses the tab strip to free vertical space and allows searching from the active tab.

citations.locator: macOS Tahoe 26.4 > enhancement list item beginning "Compact tab bar option"
citations.supports: Establishes the option and the behaviour Apple attributes to it.

concepts.title: Resize pointer alignment with rounded window corners
concepts.canonicalSummary: A pointer-behaviour defect in which the window-resize cursor does not track the actual curvature of a window corner.

citations.supports: Establishes the defect and that Apple recorded it as resolved for this version.

concepts.title: Emoji keyboard additions
concepts.canonicalSummary: An expansion of the system emoji keyboard with a set of newly encoded characters.

citations.locator: macOS Tahoe 26.4 > enhancement list item beginning "8 new emoji"
citations.supports: Establishes the count and several named characters.

concepts.title: Freeform image creation tools and premium content library
concepts.canonicalSummary: An expansion of the Freeform app with advanced image creation and editing capability and access to a subscription content library.

citations.locator: macOS Tahoe 26.4 > enhancement list item beginning "Freeform gains"
citations.supports: Establishes the capability expansion and the tie to the subscription content offering.

concepts.title: Independent payment method for adults in a family group
concepts.canonicalSummary: A Family Sharing change letting adult members pay for their own purchases instead of routing every transaction through the group organiser's payment method.

citations.locator: macOS Tahoe 26.4 > enhancement list item beginning "Purchase Sharing"
citations.supports: Establishes who the change applies to and what it changes about payment routing.

concepts.title: Faster access to subtitle and caption controls during playback
concepts.canonicalSummary: A playback-interface change that surfaces subtitle and caption options from the captions control and previews the result as settings change.

citations.locator: macOS Tahoe 26.4 > enhancement list item beginning "Subtitle and caption settings"
citations.supports: Establishes where the controls appear and that a live preview is available.

concepts.title: Support for a newer over-ear headphone model
concepts.canonicalSummary: Operating-system support for a subsequent generation of Apple's over-ear headphones.

citations.locator: macOS Tahoe 26.4 > enhancement list item reading "Support for AirPods Max 2"
citations.supports: Establishes that the update adds support for the named accessory.

concepts.title: Urgent marking and filtering in Reminders
concepts.canonicalSummary: A Reminders capability to flag an item as urgent from the keyboard and to filter Smart Lists on that state.

citations.locator: macOS Tahoe 26.4 > enhancement list item beginning "Mark reminders as urgent"
citations.supports: Establishes both the keyboard action and the Smart List filtering.

concepts.title: Networked MIDI 2.0 session support in the audio setup utility
concepts.canonicalSummary: Support for establishing MIDI 2.0 connections across a local network using a redesigned setup panel, with automatic discovery and coexistence alongside the older network MIDI transport.

citations.supports: Establishes the transport, the protocols carried, discovery, and coexistence with the earlier session type.

concepts.title: Partial-write restriction on resource-fork extended attributes
concepts.canonicalSummary: A storage behaviour under which file systems lacking native extended-attribute support restrict partial writes to an early byte range of the resource-fork attribute, requiring writers to replace the whole range or write past it.

citations.supports: Establishes the restriction, the affected file systems, the byte boundary, and the two supported write strategies.

concepts.title: Declarative configurations for intelligence, assistant, and keyboard settings
concepts.canonicalSummary: Device-management configurations that declaratively control intelligence, external intelligence, assistant, and keyboard settings, superseding the equivalent profile restrictions.

citations.locator: macOS Tahoe 26.4 > list item beginning "New declarative configurations"
citations.supports: Establishes the new configurations and the deprecation of the equivalent restriction payload keys.

concepts.title: Management controls over File Provider extension volume access
concepts.canonicalSummary: Device-management controls specifying which volumes a File Provider extension may reach and how it synchronises data.

citations.locator: macOS Tahoe 26.4 > list item beginning "New controls are available"
citations.supports: Establishes the scope of the new management controls.

concepts.title: Offline status queries for downloadable asset packs
concepts.canonicalSummary: Background Assets methods that report an asset pack's local status without a network connection, including a synchronous availability check, with a caveat that not every status field is obtainable offline.

citations.supports: Establishes both query methods, the synchronous variant, and the offline limitation.

concepts.title: Transaction revocation type and percentage fields
concepts.canonicalSummary: Additional StoreKit transaction fields describing how a transaction was revoked and to what proportion.

citations.supports: Establishes the two added transaction fields.

concepts.title: Black screen on new virtual-machine installation
concepts.canonicalSummary: A virtualisation defect in which a freshly installed macOS guest boots to a blank display on some host hardware configurations.

citations.supports: Establishes the defect, its hardware conditionality, and that Apple recorded it as resolved.

concepts.title: Boot panic when installing to an external disk on some M1 Macs
concepts.canonicalSummary: A start-up defect in which certain first-generation Apple silicon configurations panic while booting after an external-disk installation.

citations.supports: Establishes the defect, the affected silicon generation, and Apple's stated workaround.

concepts.title: Exchange synchronisation failures across Calendar, Reminders, and Notes
concepts.canonicalSummary: An account-synchronisation defect affecting Exchange data for calendar, reminder, and note content, with a stated workaround of disabling note synchronisation.

citations.supports: Establishes the affected data types and the stated workaround.

concepts.title: Sanitizer hangs when building with an older toolchain
concepts.canonicalSummary: A developer-tooling defect in which the address and thread sanitizers can hang on current OS versions when the app was built with an earlier toolchain release, resolved by building with the matching toolchain.

citations.supports: Establishes the affected sanitizers, the OS versions listed, the toolchain condition, and the workaround.

concepts.title: Monthly subscription pricing with an annual commitment
concepts.canonicalSummary: StoreKit support for a subscription billing arrangement billed monthly under a twelve-month commitment, covering price reading, purchase-time selection, entitlement metadata, and a built-in merchandising style.

citations.supports: Establishes the four API additions that together expose the commitment billing plan.

citations.locator: Paragraph beginning "The App Store is also getting"
citations.supports: Independently describes the same customer-facing pricing arrangement at the public release.

concepts.title: SMB domain-controller discovery through DNS service records
concepts.canonicalSummary: An SMB client behaviour that locates domain controllers by querying DNS service records named in the client configuration when the computer is not bound to a directory service, attempting each controller in turn and otherwise falling back to the originally supplied server name.

citations.locator: macOS Tahoe 26.5 > list item beginning "When the Mac is not bound"
citations.supports: Establishes the discovery behaviour, the record names queried, the ordering, and the fallback.

citations.locator: macOS Tahoe 26.6 > list item beginning "The srv_lookup_enabled feature"
citations.supports: Establishes that the same feature was later shipped disabled unless explicitly enabled.

concepts.title: Automatic start-up when a desktop Mac is connected to power
concepts.canonicalSummary: A setting on eligible desktop Macs that starts the computer whenever power is connected or restored, offered in the energy settings and limited to specific model years.

citations.supports: Establishes the macOS version floor and the eligible desktop model years.

citations.locator: Set your Mac to start up when power is connected
citations.supports: Establishes where the setting lives and the behaviour it produces.

concepts.title: Blank display on start-up after a software update
concepts.canonicalSummary: A start-up defect in which some computers show a blank screen after installing a system update.

citations.locator: macOS Tahoe 26.5 > list item beginning "Resolved an issue where some Mac computers"
citations.supports: Establishes the defect and that Apple recorded it as resolved for this update.

concepts.title: Suggested places in the Maps search interface
concepts.canonicalSummary: A Maps search-interface addition that surfaces suggested destinations.

citations.locator: Paragraph beginning "macOS Tahoe 26.5 adds a Suggested Places"
citations.supports: Reports the addition and where it appears.

citations.locator: Paragraph beginning "Other than that, macOS 26.5 brought in"
citations.supports: Independently attributes the same addition to the same update.

concepts.title: Deprecation of encrypted legacy HFS+ volumes
concepts.canonicalSummary: A storage deprecation announcing that encrypted volumes in the legacy Mac file format will stop being supported two major releases later, with a recommendation to move external backups to the encrypted modern format.

citations.supports: Establishes the deprecated format, the release in which support ends, and the recommended replacement.

concepts.title: Architecture deprecation alert mislabels an app as Intel-only
concepts.canonicalSummary: A defect in which the operating system's architecture deprecation alert wrongly marks an application Intel-only because a system plug-in loader has drawn translated code into that process.

citations.supports: Establishes the defect, the plug-in-loader mechanism, and that Apple recorded it as resolved.

citations.locator: Paragraph beginning "Apple's release notes for beta 1 mentioned"
citations.supports: Attributes the same fix to the release notes accompanying the first 26.6 seed.

concepts.title: Search index preparation for the next major release
concepts.canonicalSummary: Maintenance work that reorganises the system search index so the following major operating-system version can adopt it.

citations.locator: Heading "macOS Tahoe 26.6"; the single sentence beneath it
citations.supports: Establishes that Apple describes the update as optimising the search index ahead of the next major release.

citations.locator: Paragraph beginning "According to Apple's release notes"
citations.supports: Independently reports the same characterisation on release day.

concepts.title: Inflated time-weighted averages for overlapping health samples
concepts.canonicalSummary: A HealthKit defect in which time-weighted average statistics over discrete quantity types return values that are too high when the underlying samples overlap in time.

citations.supports: Establishes the query type, the overlap condition, the erroneous direction, and that Apple recorded it as resolved.

concepts.title: Corrupted appearance of high-dynamic-range screenshots in Messages
concepts.canonicalSummary: A messaging defect in which screenshots captured in high dynamic range can render incorrectly when sent.

citations.supports: Establishes the defect and that Apple recorded it as resolved.

concepts.title: Unexpected re-registration demands on Platform SSO devices
concepts.canonicalSummary: An identity defect in which computers enrolled for platform single sign-on were asked to register again without cause.

citations.locator: macOS Tahoe 26.6 > list item beginning "Resolved an issue where Platform SSO devices"
citations.supports: Establishes the defect and that Apple recorded it as resolved.

concepts.title: Local StoreKit testing does not observe subscription price edits
concepts.canonicalSummary: A testing-tool defect in which the in-editor StoreKit test environment fails to pick up changes made to subscription prices.

citations.locator: StoreKit Testing in Xcode > Known Issues; item 175848494 (FB22647785)
citations.supports: Establishes the defect and that Apple recorded it as open for this version.

concepts.title: Test sessions ignore the selected StoreKit configuration
concepts.canonicalSummary: A defect in which a unit-test StoreKit session did not adopt the selected store configuration, causing test actions to fail.

citations.supports: Establishes the defect and that Apple recorded it as resolved.
